title: Canon EOS 250D / Rebel SL3 24.1MP Ultra-Lightweight DSLR (Best Lightweight DSLR)
purpose: The world's lightest movable-screen APS-C DSLR ('Best Lightweight DSLR'): 24.1MP APS-C CMOS sensor, DIGIC 8 processor, Dual Pixel CMOS AF with Eye Detection, 5 fps shooting, 449g featherweight body, and effortless everyday portrait and street versatility with fast Canon STM primes.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 22.3 x 14.9mm APS-C CMOS sensor with Dual Pixel CMOS AF (24.1MP, 6000 x 4000)
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 1.6x Canon APS-C crop factor (~80mm portrait equivalent with 50mm f/1.8 STM)
sensor_and_optics.lens: Canon EF 50mm f/1.8 STM (80mm equivalent Fast Portrait & Everyday Prime, 7-blade circular aperture)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 100 base sensitivity (ISO 100–25,600, expandable to ISO 51,200)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 13.4 EV dynamic range with DIGIC 8 natural tonal mapping and warm Canon skin rendition
sensor_and_optics.shutter: 1/4000s to 30s focal-plane shutter, 5 fps continuous, 1/200s flash sync

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Soft natural window daylight, outdoor cafe open shade, or golden-hour park sunlight at ISO 100
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Gentle, flattering natural light transport with signature warm Canon skin tones and clean specular catchlights in the eyes

surface_rendering: 24.1MP APS-C CMOS sensor paired with Canon EF 50mm f/1.8 STM resolving natural skin pores, eyelashes, hair strands, and knitwear textures
DIGIC 8 processor delivering vibrant, authentic color reproduction and smooth highlight roll-off without artificial beauty-filter smoothing
Pure optical lens rendering with Super Spectra coating minimizing ghosting and flare
depth_and_optics: Dual Pixel CMOS AF with Eye Detection locking focus accurately on the near eye
Flattering 80mm-equivalent portrait compression with EF 50mm f/1.8 STM creating smooth, circular 7-blade optical bokeh
Spontaneous, agile handheld framing from eye-level or vari-angle low perspectives

execution_directive: Enforce Canon EOS 250D (Rebel SL3) 24.1MP lightweight DSLR optical purity with Canon EF 50mm f/1.8 STM 80mm-equivalent portrait compression and warm DIGIC 8 skin color science.
